info.title: SIM COP account erasure review proposal
info.description: Review proposal only. NOT merged into binding openapi/openapi.json, NOT a deployed or available capability. No production permission, secret, retention decision or deletion is authorized by this document. COP derives actor and all contributor identities server-side.

servers.description: Relative review context only; no available production endpoint is advertised.

post.summary: Request or resume one COP-derived driver erasure operation
post.description: Existing dedicated COP measurement bearer plus purpose-bound signed actor. COP must preserve its durable account fence and deletion queue, derive every retained/outbox contributor day and key version, and never truncate a manifest. Seven-day received-at retention plus 24-hour observation age requires UTC date(deleteAt minus eight days) through today, and any next-day date permitted by the 30-second future tolerance. Scope is online driver storage and acknowledged derived report only. SIM cannot independently prove manifest identity membership or completeness. No live speed or ETA activation.

200.description: Verified named online driver scope only; never whole-account, physical-backup or provider completion

202.description: Pending replay review, publisher review, report acknowledgement or zero verification; not erased

400.description: Invalid or incomplete manifest; no truncation

409.description: Operation identity or immutable body digest conflict

429.description: Bounded service rate limit; preserve operation ID

503.description: Disabled capability, unavailable storage or unsafe replay state; no bypass

get.summary: Read the durable driver erasure status without advancing it

200.description: Verified completed named online scope, never whole-account proof

202.description: Durable pending status, not a deletion acknowledgement

404.description: No operation visible to this actor

409.description: Operation belongs to a different actor

503.description: Capability disabled or durable store unavailable

post.summary: Request or resume one COP namespace Router erasure operation
post.description: Requires COP bearer and a purpose-bound actor, independently of BYOK or external-model flags. The browser never selects target account or payer. Fence all key mutations, reservations, BYOK chat and legacy COP generate; no shared-key fallback. Already-sent provider work cannot be unsent. Pending provider reservations, retention review or restore review prevent completion. Cost carry-forward is minimalized internal evidence without direct user linkage, not automatically anonymous.

200.description: Verified primary-database COP namespace only; named exceptions remain

202.description: Erasure remains pending; does not authorize a fallback or apparent success

403.description: Only the approved COP service may invoke this operation

503.description: Disabled capability or unavailable durable store

get.summary: Read the actor-bound Router erasure status without provider calls

200.description: Verified completed named online scope, not whole-account completion

202.description: Durable pending status, not a deletion acknowledgement

404.description: No operation visible to this actor

503.description: Capability disabled or durable store unavailable

copMeasurementBearer.description: Existing dedicated COP measurement service credential; new erasure purpose requires separate explicit approval. Never a browser credential.

copRouterBearer.description: Existing dedicated COP Router service credential; new erasure purpose requires separate explicit approval. No shared-key bypass.

ActorHeader.name: x-cop-actor
ActorHeader.description: Unpadded canonical base64url encoding of exact JSON claims sub/aud/iat/exp/operationId; audience sim-account-erasure, opaque sub 8-128 characters, lifetime at most 60 seconds, operationId bound to the request/path. COP derives it from the trusted server session. Signature timing is excluded from idempotency digest.

ActorSignature.name: x-cop-actor-signature
ActorSignature.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the exact encoded x-cop-actor under an approved server-only signer secret. No token, signature or actor content is logged.
